thread:
tamara: Received EU DSAR requesting full erase incl embeddings. Legal put a short hold for a regulator check. Need minimal keystore steps to produce deletion-proof without removing data yet. @legal-team
legal-team: Hold ID REG-900 created. We need a signed proof file and audit entries. Hold window ~48h.
ben_s: Suggest: 1) snapshot list export 2) create ephemeral HSM key 3) timebound role for ops-oncall 4) rewrap + verify -> produce proof.json 5) upload to priv-proofs and attach to case.
ops-oncall: I can run this. Will request a timebound grant for 30m and attach an audit reason `DSAR-REG-900`. Need approver.
ben_s: Approve. Keep IAM minimal: only cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on ephemeral key.
ops-oncall: Commands I will run:
```
keystore list --user U999 > preops-list.txt
# create ephemeral key, bind minimal IAM
# rewrap and verify
keystore rewrap --snapshot snap-eu-999 --to-key=projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/ephemeral-reg-900 --ephemeral-ttl=1h
keystore verify --snapshot snap-eu-999 --proof-out=reg-900-proof.json
aws s3 cp reg-900-proof.json s3://priv-proofs/REG-900/
```
ops-oncall: Grant created, expires in 30m. Audit: https://audit.internal/entries/reg-900-1 :lock:
sec-bot: Vault: REG-900 proof uploaded and audit entry recorded.
tamara: Thanks — shared proof with Legal. No deletion until hold is lifted.
